units.text: It loads PSD and PSB files, reads header and layer metadata, modifies layer properties such as name, visibility, and opacity, and saves the modified files back to disk.

It loads RGB PSD and PSB documents from a file path or stream using PsdImage.load, reads header properties such as width, height, bits per channel, color mode, compression, and channel count, and supports RGB, CMYK, and indexed-color PSD files without requiring Photoshop.
It inspects layer metadata by exposing each layer through PsdImage.getLayers, reporting the layer name, visibility, opacity, clipping, blend mode key, and position coordinates.

It edits layer metadata by allowing name, visibility, and opacity changes via setName, setVisible, and setOpacity, and writes position, clipping, and blend-mode properties while preserving the layer's pixel data.

It preserves raw file content by saving documents with a raw-preserving strategy such that documents saved without changes are identical to the loaded file, and unedited sections are copied through unchanged.
It lists image resources through getImageResources, exposing each resource's id, name, and size, while preserving their payloads on save without exposing their internal data.
It handles multiple color modes by supporting RGB, CMYK, and indexed-color PSD files during load and save operations.

The PsdImage class serves as the library's entry point for loading and saving PSD files, and it returns Layer instances through its getLayers method. Layer provides access to editable per-layer metadata such as name, visibility, and opacity.
The org.aspose package hosts the core classes PsdImage and Layer, while org.aspose.psd contains supporting types such as BlendMode and LayerMaskFlags.
It adds rendering, editing, and format conversion capabilities.
ChannelInformation class holds the channel identifier, compression method, and length of a channel.
LayerBlendModeMapper class provides the NORMAL_BLEND_MODE_KEY constant and methods to get and parse blend mode keys.
LayerMaskFlags enum lists the Disabled, InvertedWhenBlending, None, RelativeToLayer, UserMaskFromRenderingOtherData, and UserOrVectorMasksHaveParameters flag values.
LayerRecordReader class provides a load method that throws PsdLoadException (conditionally).
RawLayerMaskSection class provides the EMPTY field, rawBytes property, and load, getRawBytes methods; its load method throws PsdLoadException and RuntimeException (conditionally).
PsdImageLoader class provides a load method that throws PsdLoadException (conditionally).
IndexedColorPalette class provides the EXPECTED_RAW_LENGTH field, getEntries method, and parse and toPublicInfo methods; its parse method throws IllegalArgumentException (conditionally).
ImageResourcesSection class provides the EMPTY field, rawData and resources properties, and load, getRawData, getResources, hasResources, and save methods.
SeekOrigin enum lists the BEGIN, CURRENT, and END seek origin values.
PsdImageWriter class provides a save method that throws IOException and RuntimeException (conditionally).
